ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using Windows Media Player - Registry
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using Windows Media Player osksupport.dll (UACMe 32) Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX("\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\AppCompatFlags\\\\Compatibility\\ Assistant\\\\Store\\\\C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Windows\\ Media\\ Player\\\\osk\\\.exe$") AND Details = "Binary\ Data")
